home.hero_desc: CampusFix empowers university students, faculty, and maintenance dispatchers to report broken facilities, upvote campus repairs, track resolution stages, and keep our campus operating smoothly.
home.features_title: Everything You Need for Campus Maintenance
home.features_subtitle: Built specifically for modern universities with transparent triage and AI routing.
home.feat_1_desc: Submit facility tickets in seconds with precise building locations, categories, urgency flags, and voice notes.
home.feat_2_desc: Students and faculty can upvote common problems to signal high-impact issues for immediate facilities triage.
home.feat_3_desc: Follow your complaint in real time from submission to technician assignment and final physical verification.
home.feat_4_desc: Built-in intelligence powered by Gemini and Groq, with natural English and Urdu conversation and voice mode.
home.about_subtitle: Transforming university facility management with transparency and speed.
home.about_p1: Universities are vibrant cities within cities. When classrooms suffer from broken air conditioners, leaking water pipes, or dark staircases, education suffers.
home.about_p2: CampusFix replaces outdated paper logs and unread emails with a transparent, student-centric platform where repairs are documented, tracked, and promptly resolved.
home.hotline_notice: For active chemical spills, structural hazards, or electrical fire risks, call emergency dispatch immediately.
